arrow vkf_geometry Subroutine

An arrow (OpenFrames' Vector: a cylinder body and a cone head) from base along direction: body of length body_length and radius body_radius, then a head of length head_length and base radius head_radius, closed at the bottom of the body and of the head, with n_segments around. Triangles are counter-clockwise seen from outside; indices are 0-based; uv is zero. Sizes are given by arrow_size.

compact vkf_trajectory Subroutine

Free the storage not used: each array is reallocated to the points it holds (one copy, an array at a time), and arrays holding none are deallocated. For a trajectory that is complete: growing doubles the storage, so up to about half of it can be unused. The data and what is drawn of them don't change; pointers from times, positions, ... must be fetched again. Points can still be added (storage grows again).

Number of points to draw (1 if all sources are zero: a point at the origin).
curve_set_color vkf_artists Subroutine

The line's color: [r, g, b] (alpha unchanged) or [r, g, b, a], 0 to 1 (with the trajectory's point colors drawn: for points without one).
curve_set_dash_mode vkf_artists Subroutine

How the dash pattern (and a trail's) is laid out: DASH_SCENE (the default) anchored to the line: a dash stays put on it as the view changes, its size in scene units (one per line and view, from 0.7 to 1.4 times the pattern's on screen, changing by doubling as it zooms); DASH_SCREEN screen-locked, as OpenGL's line stipple (OpenFrames'): every dash the pattern's length in pixels, at any zoom and depth, sliding along the line as the view changes; DASH_FIXED a fixed length of the line, as paint on it: never changing, so zooming in the dashes grow on screen, and out they shrink (under a pixel, blending into a fainter solid line); length (scene units, for the whole pattern: the other patterns, a trail's future's and the arrows', in proportion), else the pattern's length on screen where the line is first drawn. DASH_SCREEN and DASH_FIXED cost projecting the points drawn on the CPU, per view and frame.
curve_set_highlight vkf_artists Subroutine

Highlight the curve (see the module documentation): mode a sum of HIGHLIGHT_PULSE and HIGHLIGHT_ARROWS (HIGHLIGHT_NONE: not highlighted), in color ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a]; default white). The other settings are kept when not given.
curve_set_pattern vkf_artists Subroutine

A dash pattern, as OpenGL's line stipple (OpenFrames' setPattern): each bit of the 16-bit pattern (bit 0 first; z'FFFF', the default, is solid) covers factor window units, along the whole curve (the dashes run on across its points). The dashes' length on screen is kept within 0.7 to 1.4 times the pattern's (see shaders/line.vert).
curve_set_trajectory vkf_artists Subroutine

curve_update vkf_artists Subroutine

Write the points added (all of them on a redraw), and draw them all, or in trace mode those passed and the tail to the point at time t, or with a trail the window about time t.
curve_width vkf_artists Function

The line's width (window units).

Where point p (root frame) is in the window, as HUD text positions: (x, y) from 0 to 1, left to right and bottom to top (as at the last frame). False if it is behind the eye (or before the first frame). E.g. to keep HUD text next to a moving object, each frame: a callout.
scroll vkf_window Subroutine

The scroll wheel: dy > 0 away from the user.
segment vkf_line_segments Subroutine

Segment i: its endpoints, and their colors (rgba).
segment_artist_pick vkf_artists Subroutine

A segment artist's best hit: on the segments drawn (as drawn: relative ends included; a segment of no length isn't drawn).
segment_build vkf_artists Subroutine

Create the chain of line buffers (sized for the segments now) under group.
segment_color vkf_artists Function

The segments' color [r, g, b, a].
segment_color vkf_line_segments Function

Color i of c (color_a or color_b), or the frame's color if c is not allocated.
segment_count vkf_artists Function

Number of segments to draw (none if all sources are zero).
segment_dash_mode vkf_artists Function

The dash pattern's layout: DASH_SCENE or DASH_SCREEN.
segment_distance vkf_line_chain Function

Distance from point v to the segment from a to b.
segment_first_drawn vkf_artists Function

The first segment drawn (1, or in trace mode of decreasing times the earliest passed): segments first_drawn .. first_drawn + num_drawn - 1.
segment_highlight vkf_artists Function

The segments' highlight: HIGHLIGHT_* (added; HIGHLIGHT_NONE: not highlighted).
segment_num_chunks vkf_artists Function

Number of line buffers the segments are drawn with (0 until built).
segment_num_drawn vkf_artists Function

Number of segments drawn now (all of them, or in trace mode those at the points passed).
segment_pattern vkf_artists Subroutine

The dash pattern: its factor and 16 pattern bits.
segment_pick vkf_pick Function

Segment a-b (root frame) passes within the tolerance (plus extra pixels, e.g. half the line's width) of the cursor: the distance (pixels) of its closest point, the fraction s of the way from a to b of that point in the scene (perspective-correct), and its depth. The part behind the eye is cut off.
segment_release vkf_artists Subroutine

Forget the render nodes (see artist_release).
segment_set_color vkf_artists Subroutine

The segments' color: [r, g, b] (alpha unchanged) or [r, g, b, a], 0 to 1.
segment_set_dash_mode vkf_artists Subroutine

The dash pattern's layout (see CurveArtist%set_dash_mode): screen-locked dashes start again at each segment's start, as GL_LINES; DASH_FIXED (strips only) is taken as DASH_SCENE.
segment_set_highlight vkf_artists Subroutine

Highlight the segments (see CurveArtist%set_highlight): the arrows run along each segment from its start to its end.
segment_set_pattern vkf_artists Subroutine

A dash pattern (see CurveArtist%set_pattern), starting again at the start of each segment.
segment_set_trajectory vkf_artists Subroutine

Draw traj; with the default data sources, from the origin to its positions (per its DOF).
segment_set_width vkf_artists Subroutine

The segments' width in window units (logical pixels).
segment_update vkf_artists Subroutine

Write the segments added (all of them on a redraw), and draw them all or, in trace mode, those at the points passed at time t.
segment_width vkf_artists Function

The segments' width (window units).
SegmentArtist vkf_artists Interface

The SegmentArtist constructor: SegmentArtist(...) makes one (see new_segment_artist for its arguments).
segments_bound vkf_line_segments Subroutine

The segments' bounding sphere (frame coordinates).
segments_build_contents vkf_line_segments Subroutine

The chain of separate segments with a color per point, under group.
segments_frame_info vkf_line_segments Function

The kind of frame: 'CustomLineSegments'.
segments_late_update vkf_line_segments Subroutine

After the tree's update for time t: the callback's segments (all frames at their positions for t), written and uploaded if they changed.
segments_set_color vkf_line_segments Subroutine

The frame's color: also that of segments set without colors.
select_view vkf_window Subroutine

Show view i (1 to num_views), flying there over duration s (default: the view transition, set_view_transition; 0: a cut).
send_lod vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Give chunk j's level of detail to the renderer (none if switched off).
separator vkf_gui Subroutine

A horizontal separator line.
set_alignment vkf_hud Subroutine

Set which point of the text is at its position.
set_attitude vkf_sky Subroutine

The sky's attitude in the root frame (quaternion [x, y, z, w]): e.g. to turn an equatorial catalog into an ecliptic root frame.
set_attitude vkf_frames Subroutine

Attitude relative to the parent frame, a quaternion [x, y, z, w] (normalized here; overridden by a followed trajectory).
set_auto_attenuate vkf_artists Subroutine

Shrink markers farther from the camera than the trajectory's size (OpenFrames' auto-attenuation; see shaders/marker.vert). On by default (OpenFrames': off).
set_auto_lod vkf_sphere Subroutine

Level of detail (default on; see the module documentation): meshes of several resolutions, the one drawn chosen per view. Off: one mesh of set_resolution's segments. Set it before a window shows the sphere.
set_axis_length vkf_shapes Subroutine

The axes' length (scene units, >= 0; default 1); the frame's own axes are moved to the lines' ends.
set_axis_width vkf_shapes Subroutine

The axis lines' width (window units; default 1).
set_background_color vkf_window Subroutine

The background color [r, g, b] (0 to 1; default black).
set_body vkf_shadow Subroutine

The body casting the shadow (it must stay alive while set), and its radius (optional: see set_body_radius).
set_body_radius vkf_shadow Subroutine

The body's radius (scene units; 0: the body's own, a Sphere's equatorial radius or a TerrainBody's).
set_callback vkf_line_segments Subroutine

Compute the segments each frame with callback (see the module documentation; it must stay alive while set).
set_camera vkf_window Subroutine

Set the camera of the current view: eye, center and up in the view frame's coordinates (OpenFrames' trackball setTransformation), or in its root frame's if in_root (as the frames are now). With duration (s), fly there from the camera shown. Before the view is shown, it is its camera when it is (View%set_camera).
set_camera_throw vkf_window Subroutine

Whether the camera keeps moving (turning, zooming, panning) after a drag is released while the mouse moves (default true, VSG's and OSG's throw); false: it stops where it is released.
set_color vkf_hud Subroutine

[r, g, b] (alpha unchanged) or [r, g, b, a], 0 to 1.
set_color vkf_frames Subroutine

The color of the frame's decorations: [r, g, b] (alpha unchanged) or [r, g, b, a].
set_compile vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Compile chunks made from now on (for the windows running): once the group is shown (not while building, when they are compiled with it).
set_cone_color vkf_shapes Subroutine

The sides' color ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a]; their alpha makes them transparent).
set_cone_length vkf_shapes Subroutine

The cone's length along the boresight (> 0; default 1).
set_constellations vkf_sky Function

Draw the constellations: faint lines between their stars, from constellation file file (found with find_data_file; read when given, or when first shown without one: default_constellations), shown (default false), in color rgba (default a faint blue, alpha 0.45) and width window units wide (default 1). Also while shown; the settings not given are kept. Returns false if the file can't be read (the constellations read before are kept) or width isn't > 0 (nothing changed).
set_constraint vkf_handles Subroutine

Where the handle can be dragged (HANDLE_*; see the module documentation), with axis: the plane's normal (HANDLE_PLANE) or the line's direction (HANDLE_LINE), in the frame's coordinates. Taken when the handle is next grabbed.
set_curve_source vkf_artists Function

Set data source k (1: x, 2: y, 3: z); returns whether the trajectory has the data.
set_dash_mode vkf_line_chain Subroutine

For lines, how the dashes are laid out: 0 anchored to the line (the default), 1 screen-locked (a constant length in pixels, following the line on screen), 2 a fixed length of the line (strips): length scene units for the pattern, or if 0 its length on screen when first drawn.
set_default_data vkf_follower Subroutine

Use the trajectories' positions (per the first trajectory's DOF).
set_default_keys vkf_window Subroutine

The built-in keys (default on): v the next view, V the previous one, the space bar resets the view.
set_default_view_distance vkf_view Subroutine

The radius to frame when the view is reset (<= 0: the viewed frame's bound, the default), as OpenFrames' default view distance.
set_default_view_parameters vkf_view Subroutine

The camera after a reset, in view-frame coordinates (overrides the default view distance).
set_display_scale vkf_handles Subroutine

Scene units per unit of the vector (> 0; default 1): the arrow is scale * vector.
set_dof vkf_trajectory Subroutine

Set the degrees of freedom (2 or 3) of positions and optionals; clears the trajectory.
set_draggable vkf_handles Subroutine

Whether the mouse may grab the handle (default true).
set_draw_axes vkf_shapes Subroutine

Which axes to draw: an ior of X_AXIS, Y_AXIS, Z_AXIS.
set_draw_mode vkf_sky Subroutine

What to draw: SKY_NONE, or SKY_TEXTURE + SKY_STARS (default; each only if given).
set_draw_mode vkf_shapes Subroutine

What to draw: an ior of CONE_SIDES, CONE_EDGES, CONE_BASE_OUTLINE.
set_edges vkf_shapes Subroutine

The edges drawn (2, k) (vertex numbers), in place of the faces' (after set_faces, set_triangles or set_grid).
set_end_data vkf_artists Function

All three end sources at once (see set_start_data).
set_end_relative vkf_artists Subroutine

Relative ends (default false): each segment ends at its start plus the end sources' values (a vector drawn from each point), not at them.
set_end_scale vkf_artists Subroutine

Set the scale of all three end sources (with relative ends: the length drawn per unit of the stored vector, e.g. km per newton). Only this artist's segments are written again.
set_end_x_data vkf_artists Function

Where the x of the segments' end points come from (see set_start_x_data).
set_end_y_data vkf_artists Function

Where the y of the segments' end points come from (see set_start_x_data).
set_end_z_data vkf_artists Function

Where the z of the segments' end points come from (see set_start_x_data).
set_event_handler vkf_window Subroutine

Give the window's keyboard and mouse events to handler (not owned: it must stay alive while set), in place of any handler set before.
set_face_color vkf_shapes Subroutine

The faces' color (the alpha times the opacity).
set_faces vkf_shapes Subroutine

Faces given as polygons: faces the vertex numbers (1-based) of each polygon in turn, sizes how many each has (>= 3; convex, or at least star-shaped from its first vertex: drawn as a fan of triangles from it); the edges are the polygons' sides. E.g. a cube: 8 vertices, 6 faces of 4. A face's front: its vertices counterclockwise.
set_follow_type vkf_follower Subroutine

What to follow (FOLLOW_POSITION and/or FOLLOW_ATTITUDE, combined with ior) and how (FOLLOW_LOOP or FOLLOW_LIMIT).
set_font vkf_hud Subroutine

Set the font (the text is made again when next drawn).
set_grid vkf_shapes Subroutine

Faces given as a grid of points (3, nu, nv): quadrilaterals between neighbours (two triangles each), joined around if closed_u (the last point i to the first, for each j; e.g. a tube's circumference) or closed_v. The edges: the grid's lines, those of constant i (along j) every lines(1) and of constant j (along i) every lines(2) (default: every one; 0 for none).
set_head_size vkf_handles Subroutine

The head's length (scene units; at most half the arrow); 0 (the default): 0.2 of the arrow's length.
set_highlight vkf_line_chain Subroutine

For lines, the highlight (see shaders/line.vert): flags (1 pulse, 2 arrows; 0 none), its color (rgba), the arrows' spacing and speed (window units, and per second), the band's width (window units) and the pulse's period (s).
set_hovered vkf_handles Subroutine

The handle is under the cursor (set by the window), or not.
set_intermediate_direction vkf_artists Subroutine

Count intermediate markers from the start (MARKER_START, default) or from the end (MARKER_END; recomputed whenever points are added).
set_intermediate_spacing vkf_artists Subroutine

Spacing of intermediate markers (> 0): time units, arc length, or a number of data points (rounded down, at least 1).
set_intermediate_type vkf_artists Subroutine
set_label_alignment vkf_frames Subroutine

The alignment of the labels relative to their positions (ALIGN_*; default ALIGN_LEFT_BASE_LINE).
set_label_font vkf_frames Subroutine

The font of the labels: a font file name (found on the data search path) or a full path; default: the renderer's default font.
set_label_size vkf_frames Subroutine

The size of the labels in pixels (default 20): the name label's size, and the maximum size of the axes labels (which shrink with distance).
set_length vkf_shadow Subroutine

How far behind the body's center the shadow is drawn (scene units; 0: automatic, twice the umbra's length).
set_level_of_detail vkf_artists Subroutine

Level of detail (default on): seen from far away, the curve is drawn from every 2nd, 4th, ... point (and its last), as many as can be skipped while staying within half a pixel of all of them, chosen per view and per chunk of points. Off: every point is drawn.
set_light vkf_shadow Subroutine

The light (e.g. the Sun; it must stay alive while set), and its radius (optional: see set_light_radius).
set_light_ambient vkf_window Subroutine

The ambient, diffuse and specular colors ([r, g, b], 0 to 1) of the window's light (OpenFrames' defaults: 0.2 gray, white, none). The window's light is used while no frame of the scene has a light source (ReferenceFrame%set_light_source_enabled).
set_light_ambient vkf_frames Subroutine

The light source's ambient, diffuse and specular colors ([r, g, b], 0 to 1; defaults 0.05, 0.8 and 0.05 gray).
set_light_diffuse vkf_window Subroutine

The diffuse color of the window's light (see set_light_ambient).
set_light_diffuse vkf_frames Subroutine

The light source's diffuse color (see set_light_ambient).
set_light_position vkf_window Subroutine

The light's position in eye coordinates (x right, y up, z toward the viewer): [x, y, z, 0] for a directional light from direction (x, y, z), [x, y, z, 1] for a point light (OpenFrames' setLightPosition; default [0, 0, 1, 0], a headlight).
set_light_radius vkf_shadow Subroutine

The light's radius (scene units; 0: the light's own, if a Sphere).
set_light_source_enabled vkf_frames Subroutine

Whether this frame carries a light source: a point light at its origin (e.g. the Sun), not dimmed with distance (default false; OpenFrames' setLightSourceEnabled). While any frame of a window's scene has one, the window's own light (WindowProxy%set_light_*) is off.
set_light_specular vkf_window Subroutine

The specular color of the window's light (see set_light_ambient).
set_light_specular vkf_frames Subroutine

The light source's specular color (see set_light_ambient).
set_lighting vkf_terrain Subroutine

Light the body with the scene's lights (default), or show its imagery as it is.
set_line_width vkf_line_segments Subroutine

Line width (window units: logical pixels).
set_line_widths vkf_shapes Subroutine

Widths of the grid lines and of the equator and prime meridian (window units; defaults 1 and 3).
set_lit vkf_shapes Subroutine

Faces lit by the scene's lights (the default), or unlit (their color as is, transparent as a cone's sides: writing no depth).
set_lod vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Level of detail on (the default: seen from far away, a strip is drawn from fewer points, within half a pixel of all of them) or off (every point drawn).
set_marker_color vkf_artists Subroutine

The color of the markers in which (an ior of MARKER_* flags): [r, g, b] (alpha unchanged) or [r, g, b, a].
set_marker_image vkf_artists Function

Draw the markers as an image file (tinted by the marker color; its transparent parts left out), or as a disk again with ''. Returns false if the image cannot be read (the markers are then unchanged).
set_marker_shape vkf_artists Subroutine

Marker shape: a MARKER_ shape constant (MARKER_DISK to MARKER_SPIRAL; MARKER_IMAGE after set_marker_image). These are OpenFrames' disk and its marker shaders (Demos/Shaders/Marker_.frag), built in.
set_marker_shape vkf_handles Subroutine

The marker's shape (a MARKER_* shape of vkf_artists but MARKER_IMAGE; default MARKER_DISK).
set_marker_size vkf_artists Subroutine

Marker size in window units (logical pixels; > 0).
set_marker_size vkf_handles Subroutine

The marker's size (window units, > 0; default 14).
set_marker_source vkf_artists Function

Set data source k (1: x, 2: y, 3: z), redrawing the markers; returns whether the trajectory has the data.
set_marker_style vkf_line_chain Subroutine

For markers, the color (rgba), size (window units), shape (shaders/marker.frag) and attenuation radius (scene units, 0 for none).
set_markers vkf_artists Subroutine

Which markers to draw: an ior of MARKER_START, MARKER_INTERMEDIATE and MARKER_END (0 for none).
set_material vkf_sphere Subroutine

The material (OpenFrames' setMaterial; each optional): ambient, diffuse, specular and emission colors ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], 0 to 1) and shininess (0 to 128: the specular highlight's sharpness; 0 for none). The ambient and diffuse colors scale the body's color or texture (VSG's Phong); the specular color is reflected from the lights' specular parts. Defaults: ambient and diffuse white, no specular reflection or emission.
set_model vkf_model Function

Read the model file (now, so its bound is known). Returns false if it could not be read. Set it before a window first shows the model.
set_model_attitude vkf_model Subroutine

Attitude of the model in its frame (quaternion [x, y, z, w]).
set_model_pivot vkf_model Subroutine

The point of the model (in its own coordinates) placed at model_position, about which it is rotated and scaled.
set_model_position vkf_model Subroutine

Where the model's pivot is placed in its frame (frame coordinates).
set_model_scale vkf_model Subroutine

Scale along the model's x, y and z axes.
set_name vkf_frames Subroutine

The frame's name, shown by its name label (also once shown: e.g. a readout that follows the frame).
set_name_label_on_top vkf_frames Subroutine

Draw the name label on top of the scene (true: not hidden by bodies in front of it, as HUD text; e.g. a readout) or depth-tested (false, the default, as OpenFrames').
set_night_texture_map vkf_sphere Subroutine

The texture for the side away from the light (e.g. city lights; an equirectangular image file as the texture, '' for none), shown where the diffuse light is weak.
set_num_optionals vkf_trajectory Subroutine

Set the number of optional vectors per position; clears the trajectory.
set_offset_time vkf_follower Subroutine

Follow at the simulation time plus offset (the default, offset 0).
set_opacity vkf_sphere Subroutine

The body's opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque, the default): below 1 it is drawn translucent (see the module documentation). Set below 1 before a window first shows it to make it translucent; then the opacity can change at any time (a translucent body stays translucent, an opaque one opaque).
set_optional vkf_trajectory Subroutine

Set optional vector index (1 to num_optionals) of the most recently added position. ok is false if there is no position or no such optional.
set_orthographic vkf_view Subroutine

An orthographic projection with the given bounds (in view units).
set_path vkf_handles Subroutine

The path the handle moves along (which must stay alive while used); its time kept (the frame placed on the new path).
set_pattern vkf_line_segments Subroutine

Dash pattern: OpenGL's line stipple (16 bits, bit 0 first, each factor window units; 65535: solid), as CurveArtist%set_pattern.
set_pattern vkf_line_chain Subroutine

For lines, a dash pattern (see line_set_pattern; z'FFFF' solid).
set_perspective vkf_view Subroutine

A perspective projection with vertical field of view fovy (degrees; default 45).
set_pickable vkf_frames Subroutine

Whether pick tests what this frame draws (default true; e.g. false for an overlay such as a selection marker). Its children are picked or not by their own setting.
set_plane_color vkf_shapes Subroutine

The plane's color ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a]; default 0.8 gray, 0.2 opaque).
set_point_color vkf_shapes Subroutine

The vertices' color (POLY_VERTICES).
set_point_colors vkf_artists Subroutine

Whether a trajectory with colors is drawn in them (default true); points without a color yet (colors arriving after positions) in the artist's color. A curve: each segment blended from its first point's color to its second's (with level of detail, a color lasting fewer points than are skipped may not show from far away); a surface: each point's pair in its color, times the artist's alpha. False: all in the artist's color.
set_point_size vkf_shapes Subroutine

The vertices' size (window units; default 6).
set_position vkf_hud Subroutine

Set where the text is.
set_position vkf_frames Subroutine

Position relative to the parent frame (overridden by a followed trajectory).
set_priority vkf_handles Subroutine

The handle's priority over others on the same spot of the screen (higher first; default 0, a TimeHandle's 1; see the module documentation).
set_radius vkf_sphere Subroutine

The sphere's radius (scene units, > 0; default 1); can change at any time.
set_region_color vkf_shadow Subroutine

A region's color (region: one of SHADOW_UMBRA, SHADOW_PENUMBRA, SHADOW_ANTUMBRA; [r, g, b], alpha unchanged, or [r, g, b, a]).
set_regions vkf_shadow Subroutine

The regions to draw: an ior of SHADOW_UMBRA, SHADOW_PENUMBRA and SHADOW_ANTUMBRA (default SHADOW_ALL).
set_resolution vkf_sphere Subroutine

The mesh resolution without level of detail: segments in longitude and latitude (default 128 x 64).
set_rgba vkf_math Subroutine

Set rgba from color: [r, g, b] (alpha unchanged) or [r, g, b, a].
set_ribbon_source vkf_artists Function

Set component k of the start (side 1) or end (side 2) sources.
set_scene vkf_window Subroutine

Show the scene of fm (which must stay alive while shown). For now, set it before the window's first frame.
set_segment_source vkf_artists Function

Set component k of the start (side 1) or end (side 2) sources.
set_segments vkf_line_segments Subroutine

The segments: from a(:, i) to b(:, i) (frame coordinates), colored color_a(:, i) at a and color_b(:, i) at b ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] columns; one of them for both ends; neither: the frame's color). Setting the same segments again changes nothing (no upload).
set_size vkf_hud Subroutine

Set the size of the text.
set_sky vkf_window Subroutine

Draw sky behind the scene (it must stay alive while shown; it can be shown in several windows), in place of the window's sky so far; at any time (its texture and stars can change too).
set_smooth vkf_shapes Subroutine

Shading smooth across the vertices (normals averaged over the faces around each: a curved surface, e.g. a grid's), or flat faces (the default: a polyhedron's).
set_sphere_attitude vkf_sphere Subroutine

Attitude of the body in its frame (quaternion [x, y, z, w]), e.g. to orient its texture.
set_sphere_position vkf_sphere Subroutine

Position of the body's center in its frame.
set_sphere_scale vkf_sphere Subroutine

Scale the sphere along its x, y and z axes (all > 0), making an ellipsoid with semi-axes radius * scale.
set_star_data vkf_sky Function

Draw the stars of catalog (found with find_data_file; '' for none) with magnitudes from min_mag to max_mag (default -2 to 8), at most max_stars (default 10000), sized from min_size to max_size window units (default 1 to 10) by brightness, the smallest dimmed to min_dim_ratio (0 to 1, default 0.5) of their color (OpenFrames' setSkySphereStarData). Returns false if the catalog cannot be read or the limits are invalid (min_mag > max_mag, max_stars < 1, min_size > max_size, a ratio outside 0 to 1).
set_star_names vkf_sky Function

Draw the names of the named stars drawn (those of the catalog's last field), beside them: shown (default false), of the stars up to magnitude max_mag (default all of them), size window units tall (default 12), in color rgba (default a pale blue) and font font ('' or default: vkframes' default font). Also while shown; the settings not given are kept. Returns false (nothing changed) if size isn't > 0.
set_start_data vkf_artists Function

All three start (end) sources at once, e.g. position_sources(3) or optional_sources(1). Returns whether the trajectory has their data.
set_start_x_data vkf_artists Function

Where the x (y, z) of the segments' start (end) points come from. Returns whether the trajectory has the data of all sources.
set_start_y_data vkf_artists Function

Where the y of the segments' start points come from (see set_start_x_data).
set_start_z_data vkf_artists Function

Where the z of the segments' start points come from (see set_start_x_data).
set_stride vkf_artists Subroutine

Draw a segment at points 1, 1 + stride, 1 + 2 stride, ... (stride >= 1).
set_style vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Color (rgba) and width (window units) of the whole chain.
set_text vkf_hud Subroutine

Set the text (up to 256 characters, or twice the first text's length; see the module documentation).
set_texture_map vkf_sky Function

Draw an image file as the sky (found with find_data_file); '' for none. Returns false if it cannot be read (the sky is then unchanged).
set_texture_map vkf_sphere Subroutine

The texture: an equirectangular image file ('' for none).
set_tick_image vkf_shapes Function

Draw the ticks as an image (OpenFrames' setTickImage; found with find_data_file; '' for disks again). False if it cannot be read.
set_tick_shape vkf_shapes Subroutine

Tick shape: a MARKER_* shape (default MARKER_DISK; OpenFrames' setTickShader with its marker shaders).
set_tick_size vkf_shapes Subroutine

Major and minor tick sizes (window units; default 8 and 4).
set_tick_spacing vkf_shapes Subroutine

Major and minor tick spacings (>= 0; 0 for none).
set_time vkf_follower Subroutine

Follow at a fixed time (independent of the simulation time).
set_time vkf_clock Subroutine

Set the simulation time (limited to the time range) and restart counting from it.
set_time vkf_window Subroutine

Set the simulation time (limited to the time range).
set_time vkf_handles Subroutine

The handle's time (kept within its time range): the frame placed at the path's point for it.
set_time_range vkf_clock Subroutine

Limit the simulation time to [t_min, t_max] (ignored if t_max < t_min).
set_time_range vkf_window Subroutine

Limit the simulation time to [t_min, t_max] (ignored if t_max < t_min).
set_time_range vkf_handles Subroutine

The times a drag may reach (t_min <= t_max; else swapped); the handle's time brought within them. Taken at the next grab.
set_time_scale vkf_clock Subroutine

Simulation seconds per wall-clock second (may be 0 or negative).
set_time_scale vkf_window Subroutine

Simulation seconds per wall-clock second (may be 0 or negative).
set_trace_mode vkf_artists Subroutine

Draw only the part up to the current time (see the module documentation).
set_trail vkf_artists Subroutine

A trail (see the module documentation): only the part within past before the current time and future after it (s, >= 0; 0: none of it; huge(1.0_wp): no limit), each fading out over the last fade (0 to 1, default 0.25) of its window toward its cutoff. Replaces trace mode while set.
set_trail vkf_line_chain Subroutine

For strips, the trail (see vkf_line_set_trail: 20 values; the third 0: none), given to every chunk (changed every frame the time does: a few floats per chunk uploaded).
set_trail_style vkf_artists Subroutine

The style of a trail's part, which TRAIL_PAST or TRAIL_FUTURE: color ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a]: drawn in it instead of the line's colors), opacity (its alpha multiplied by it: translucency, default 1), a dash pattern (factor and 16 pattern bits, as set_pattern; default solid). Settings not given are kept.
set_trajectory vkf_follower Subroutine

Follow only traj (none if it is not associated).
set_trajectory vkf_artists Subroutine

Draw traj (it must stay alive while drawn).
set_triangles vkf_shapes Subroutine

Faces given as triangles (3, m) of vertex numbers (1-based); the edges are their sides (each once).
set_twilight vkf_sphere Subroutine

The twilight: the diffuse light extended past the terminator to where the light is angle (radians, 0 to 1.5) below the horizon, fading out smoothly (where it meets the light on the day side: the same brightness and slope, so no line shows), and the night texture fading in across it. 0 (the default): none, the light ends at the terminator (an airless body). Not in OpenFrames. Can change at any time.
set_two_sided vkf_shapes Subroutine

Both sides of the faces drawn and lit (the default: open surfaces), or only their fronts (a closed surface, its faces counterclockwise seen from outside: translucent, its far side isn't drawn through it).
set_vector vkf_handles Subroutine

The vector (frame coordinates); can change at any time.
set_vertex_angles vkf_shapes Subroutine

The vertices: clock angles (from +x toward +y) and cone angles (from the boresight, -z; below 90 degrees), radians, the same number of each (>= 3).
set_vertex_colors vkf_shapes Subroutine

A color per vertex (4, n) or (3, n) ([r, g, b(, a)], 0 to 1), for the faces, blended across them (in place of the face color; the opacity still applies). Dropped when the faces are set again.
set_vertices vkf_shapes Subroutine

Move the vertices (3, n), keeping the faces and edges (as many as before; e.g. a surface changing in time).
set_view_between_frames vkf_view Subroutine

Look from frame at lookat (both in the tree of root).
set_view_frame vkf_view Subroutine

View frame (in the tree of root) with base frame_type (default RELATIVE_FRAME).
set_view_transition vkf_window Subroutine

The time (s) a change of view or a reset flies from one camera to the other (default 0: a cut, as OpenFrames).
set_x_data vkf_follower Function

Where the x, y and z of the followed position come from (default: the trajectories' positions). Returns whether all followed trajectories have those data.
set_x_data vkf_artists Function

Where the x (y, z) of the points come from. Returns whether the trajectory has those data.
set_x_label vkf_frames Subroutine

The text of the x-axis label (default 'X').
set_y_data vkf_follower Function

Where the y of the followed position comes from (see set_x_data).
set_y_data vkf_artists Function

Where the y of the points come from (see set_x_data).
set_y_label vkf_frames Subroutine

The text of the y-axis label (default 'Y').
set_z_data vkf_follower Function

Where the z of the followed position comes from (see set_x_data).
set_z_data vkf_artists Function

Where the z of the points come from (see set_x_data).
set_z_label vkf_frames Subroutine

The text of the z-axis label (default 'Z').
set_zoom_speed vkf_window Subroutine

How fast the mouse zooms (default 1, VSG's: 10% per wheel step, and a right drag's rate): e.g. 0.3 for a gentler zoom. Scales scroll steps however they come (a mouse wheel, a trackpad, a host's scroll).
shadow_bound vkf_shadow Subroutine

The drawn regions' bounding sphere (frame coordinates).
shadow_build_contents vkf_shadow Subroutine

A switch with a mesh for each region (vertices written at each change of shape), under group.
shadow_frame_info vkf_shadow Function

What kind of frame this is: 'ShadowCones'.
shadow_late_update vkf_shadow Subroutine

After the tree's update for time t: the shadow moved to the body, turned away from the light, and reshaped if the distance or a setting changed.
ShadowCones vkf_shadow Interface

The ShadowCones constructor: ShadowCones(...) makes one (see new_shadow_cones for its arguments).
shape_regions vkf_shadow Subroutine

The regions' frustums for body radius r, light radius rs and distance d (see the module documentation), written to their meshes.
share_model vkf_model Function

Use the model already read by other (no second copy in memory).
show vkf_hud Subroutine

Show (true) or hide the text (OpenFrames' enable HUD text).
show_axes vkf_frames Subroutine

Which axes vectors to show: NO_AXES, or X_AXIS, Y_AXIS, Z_AXIS combined with ior.
show_axes_labels vkf_frames Subroutine

Which axes labels to show (as show_axes).
show_contents vkf_frames Subroutine

Show or hide what the frame draws (its sphere, model, ...), but not its axes, labels or children.
show_decorations vkf_frames Subroutine

Show (true) or hide all the frame's decorations at once: its axes, their labels and its name label (show_axes, show_axes_labels, show_name_label).
show_name_label vkf_frames Subroutine

Show or hide the name label (at the frame's origin; default shown).
side vkf_shapes Function

Which side of the line from a to b q is on: > 0 left, < 0 right, 0 on it (twice the signed area of the triangle a, b, q).
size vkf_hud Function

The size of the text: character height (window units).
size_of vkf_sky Function

The number of columns of a (the stars' capacity).
sky vkf_window Function

The sky drawn behind the scene (null if none).
sky_direction vkf_sky Function

The unit vector of a direction on the sky from its right ascension (hours) and declination (degrees), as the stars' (star_to_point).
slice vkf_line_chain Subroutine

The part lo .. hi of points i1 .. i2 that chunk j holds, and its buffer p(xyz and distance, high/low, lo:hi) (null if none).
slider vkf_gui Function

A slider showing value, from low to high: true (and value changed) after the user moved it. format: how the value is shown (printf's, e.g. '%.0f km'; default '%.4g').
smooth vkf_shapes Function

Whether the shading is smooth.
sort_keys vkf_shapes Subroutine

Sort keys, increasing (a bottom-up merge sort).
source_points vkf_artists Function

Number of points the data sources give: 0 for invalid sources or no trajectory, huge() if all are zero.
Sphere vkf_sphere Interface

The Sphere constructor: Sphere(...) makes one (see new_sphere for its arguments).
sphere_attitude vkf_sphere Function

Attitude of the body in its frame (quaternion [x, y, z, w]).
sphere_bound vkf_sphere Subroutine

The body's bounding sphere: its center, and its largest semi-axis.
sphere_build_contents vkf_sphere Subroutine

The body: an ellipsoid mesh under the sphere's transform.
sphere_create vkf_geometry Function

A sphere mesh node: ellipsoid_create with equal semi-axes.
sphere_frame_info vkf_sphere Function

What kind of frame this is: 'Sphere'.
sphere_near vkf_pick Function

A sphere (root frame: center c, radius r) might be within the tolerance (plus extra pixels) of the cursor on the screen (false only if it surely isn't: to skip what it bounds).
sphere_pick vkf_sphere Subroutine

Picked on the ellipsoid (exact), with the geodetic latitude and longitude of the point hit (in the body's axes: sphere_attitude); else the frame's origin.
sphere_position vkf_sphere Function

Position of the body's center in its frame (scene units).
sphere_scale vkf_sphere Function

The scale along the sphere's x, y and z axes.
sphere_set_color vkf_sphere Subroutine

The body's color (used without a texture); [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a].
sphere_update vkf_sphere Subroutine

Update the frame (followed trajectories, children) and, with level of detail, build the mesh the views have wanted if it isn't built yet (the coarsest with as many segments as wanted, or the finest).
split_distances vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Distances s(n) into d(high/low, n).
split_points vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Points x(3, n) into p(xyz and distance, high/low, n): the floats nearest, and the rest (the distances are left as they are).
star vkf_sky Subroutine

Star i (1 to num_stars): its direction (unit vector, sky frame), color (rgb, dimmed) and size (window units).
star_catalog vkf_sky Function

The star catalog file ('' for none).
star_magnitude_range vkf_sky Function

The range of magnitudes of the stars read.
star_magnitudes vkf_sky Function

The magnitude range drawn (as set).
star_name vkf_sky Subroutine

Named star i (1 to num_star_names): its name, apparent magnitude and star (1 to num_stars: see star).
star_names vkf_sky Function

Whether the star names are drawn (as set).
star_sizes vkf_sky Function

The size range of the stars (window units).
star_to_point vkf_sky Subroutine

A star's direction, color (from its B-V color index: Ballesteros' temperature, then Tanner Helland's temperature to RGB) and raw size (OpenFrames' SkySphere::StarToPoint).
start_data_sources vkf_artists Function

The x, y and z data sources of the segments' start points.
start_flight vkf_window Subroutine

Fly from camera start (in view from's frame) to finish (in view to's) over duration s, from now.
start_recording vkf_window Function

Start recording the frames drawn to the video file (see the module documentation), fps frames per second (default 30). Encoded by codec (an ffmpeg encoder; default libx264, H.264) at quality (for libx264, libx265 and libvpx-vp9 the CRF: 0 lossless to 51, default 18, visually lossless), scaled by scale (default 1; e.g. 0.5 for half the size of a Retina window's pixels), the size made even. options replaces the encoder options (codec, quality; and the scale, unless there is a watermark), e.g. '-c:v prores_ks -profile:v 3'. watermark: an image (e.g. a logo; PNG, SVG, ... with transparency) drawn over the video's bottom right corner by ffmpeg, watermark_width of the video's width (default 0.2), watermark_opacity opaque (default 0.6). ffmpeg: the program (default: VKFRAMES_FFMPEG, else ffmpeg on the path). Returns false if the window isn't open, is already recording or the watermark doesn't exist; ffmpeg's errors (e.g. an unknown encoder) show when it starts, at the next frame, and end the recording.
stop_recording vkf_window Function

Stop recording: ffmpeg finishes the file. The window's time goes on from where the video was, on the wall clock again. frames: the frames written. Returns false if not recording or if the recording failed (ffmpeg's messages are on the standard error).
stop_transition vkf_window Subroutine

End a flight where the camera is now.
storage_bytes vkf_trajectory Function

The memory the trajectory's data take (bytes), used or not: its storage's capacity (see reserve, compact).
stride vkf_artists Function

The stride: a segment at every stride-th point.
style_node vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Give the chain's style to line, a node not in the chain (e.g. a curve's trace-mode tail, drawn as part of it).
surface_node vkf_shapes Function

A surface of triangles idx(3, m) (1-based) through points xyz(3, n), of color rgba: unlit and transparent (seen from both sides, writing no depth: planes, cones' sides), or, given normals, lit by the scene's lights: opaque, or translucent if an alpha is below 1 (drawn after the opaque scene, sorted by depth by the bounding sphere sphere); two_sided: both faces drawn and lit. colors: a color per vertex (4, n), times rgba.
surface_point vkf_shapes Function

The point at geodetic latitude lat and longitude lon on the ellipsoid (OpenFrames' LatLonGrid formula: the surface point whose normal has those angles).
sync vkf_frames Subroutine

Copy the positions and attitudes of this frame and its descendants to their transform nodes (only those that changed since the last sync).
synchronize vkf_clock Function

Follow master's time (it must stay alive while synchronized), or stop following (master not associated, or this clock itself), keeping the master's current time and settings. Returns false, and changes nothing, if this would make a cycle.
synchronized_to vkf_clock Function

The clock this one is synchronized to (null if none).
tail_colors vkf_artists Subroutine

The tail's colors: from point k's to the color at frac along to point k2's (white, showing the style's color, if the chain has none).
tail_ends vkf_artists Subroutine

Trace mode's tail, for the points passed i1 .. i2 of the n written: from the latest passed (k) toward the next in time (k2: i2 + 1, or i1 - 1 for decreasing times); none (0, 0) without a trajectory.
take_camera vkf_view Function

True (once) if a camera was set (set_camera), and that camera.
take_reset vkf_view Function

True (once) if a reset is pending.
terrain_bound vkf_terrain Subroutine

The body's bounding sphere (frame coordinates): its equatorial radius, at the origin.
terrain_build_contents vkf_terrain Subroutine

The map, made for the viewer showing the body (none headless or without Rocky).
terrain_frame_info vkf_terrain Function

The kind of frame: 'TerrainBody'.
terrain_pick vkf_terrain Subroutine

Picked on a sphere of the body's radius (not the terrain's heights), with the latitude and longitude of the point hit; else the frame's origin.
terrain_update vkf_terrain Subroutine

Each frame: if the map's window has closed (the map was released with it), the map again for a window still open (compiled for the windows running), then the frame's update.
TerrainBody vkf_terrain Interface

The TerrainBody constructor: TerrainBody(...) makes one (see new_terrain_body for its arguments).
text vkf_gui Subroutine

A line of text.
text vkf_hud Function

The text (as shown: '' while hidden).
texture_map vkf_sky Function

The texture file ('' for none).
texture_map vkf_sphere Function

The texture file ('' for none).
tick_image vkf_shapes Function

The tick image file ('' for none).
tick_shape vkf_shapes Function

Tick shape: a MARKER_* shape.
tick_size vkf_shapes Subroutine

Major and minor tick sizes (window units).
tick_spacing vkf_shapes Subroutine

Major and minor tick spacings.
time vkf_trajectory Function

Time i.
time vkf_clock Function

The simulation time at the last update (or as last set).
time vkf_window Function

The simulation time (at the last frame).
time vkf_handles Function

The handle's time.
time_bound vkf_handles Subroutine

The marker's bounding sphere: the frame's origin.
time_build_contents vkf_handles Subroutine

The marker: one point at the frame's origin.
time_distance vkf_trajectory Function

The "distance" from time t to the time range [t0, tf]: > 0 outside it (to the nearer end), 0 at its ends, < 0 inside; huge() without times. (OpenFrames' getTimeDistance.)
time_drag vkf_handles Function

Drag the grabbed handle to the cursor's ray (origin, unit dir; root frame): its time where the path is nearest the ray (see the module documentation). False (not moved) if it isn't grabbed or the path is all behind the eye.
time_fraction vkf_trajectory Function

The fraction of the way in time from point k to point k2 (any two points: e.g. k + 1, or k - 1 with times running backward) at time t, kept within 0 to 1 (0 if their times are the same). No checks: k and k2 must be times.
time_frame_info vkf_handles Function

What kind of frame this is: 'TimeHandle'.
time_grab vkf_handles Function

Grab the handle with the cursor's ray (origin, unit dir; root frame): the path sampled over the time range. False if it isn't draggable or has no path.
time_handle_point vkf_handles Function

The point the mouse grabs: the marker, at the frame's origin.
time_index vkf_trajectory Function

Find the interval of the time list containing t, by bisection (times increasing or decreasing). Returns a TIME_ code, or the number of iterations (> 0) when found, with times(index) <= t < times(index+1) for increasing times (>= and > for decreasing). See the TIME_ constants for index in the other cases.
time_move_handle_point vkf_handles Subroutine

The handle moved to the sampled point of the path nearest p (frame coordinates; after a grab: the path's points are sampled then).
time_pick vkf_handles Subroutine

Picked at its marker (within the tolerance plus half its size), as PICK_HANDLE; else the frame's origin.
time_range vkf_trajectory Function

The first and last times, ordered (t0 <= tf); false if there are no times.
time_range vkf_clock Subroutine

The time range the simulation time is limited to (s; +-huge() if unlimited).
time_range vkf_window Subroutine

The simulation time range (set_time_range).
time_range vkf_handles Subroutine

The times a drag may reach.
time_scale vkf_clock Function

Simulation seconds per wall-clock second.
time_scale vkf_window Function

Simulation seconds per wall-clock second.
time_set_color vkf_handles Subroutine

The marker's color; [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a].
time_show_state vkf_handles Subroutine

The marker's color and size: brighter and larger when hovered, more when dragged.
TimeHandle vkf_handles Interface

The TimeHandle constructor: TimeHandle(...) makes one (see new_time_handle for its arguments).
times vkf_trajectory Subroutine

Pointer to the times (num_times), without copying.
tip vkf_handles Function

The arrow's tip: the display scale times the vector (frame coordinates).
to_float_rgba vkf_trajectory Subroutine

rgba from [r, g, b] (alpha 1) or [r, g, b, a].
trace_end vkf_artists Function

In trace mode, the end of the line (the point at the current time) as drawn; false if no tail is drawn.

Whether only the part up to the current time is drawn.
trace_range vkf_artists Subroutine

The points of 1 .. n whose times are at most t (trace mode): i1 .. i2 (none: i2 < i1), the first points for increasing times, the last for decreasing ones (by bisection).

unit_part vkf_handles Function

update vkf_follower Subroutine

update_tail vkf_artists Subroutine

update_window_light vkf_window Subroutine

The window's light on while no frame of the scene has a light source.

vector vkf_handles Function

vector_build_contents vkf_handles Subroutine

The arrow: a unit shaft and head under their transforms, in a switch.

What kind of frame this is: 'VectorHandle'.

The point the mouse grabs: the tip.
vector_move_handle_point vkf_handles Subroutine

Picked at its tip and along its head (within the tolerance, plus a few pixels), as PICK_HANDLE; else the frame's origin.

vsg_alignment vkf_text Subroutine

The horizontal and vertical alignments of vsg::StandardLayout for an ALIGN_* constant (vkf_frames: 0 left-top ... 8 right-bottom, 9 to 11 base line).
vulkan_device_name vkf_layer Function

Name of the first Vulkan physical device, or an empty string if there is none.
wall_time vkf_clock Function

Wall-clock time in seconds (system_clock), for the clock's default.
wants vkf_pick Function

Hits of kind (vkf_frames' PICK_*) are wanted.
window_gui vkf_window Function

The window's GUI panels (vkf_gui), made on first use: with font (a font file name or path, as labels'; default DejaVu Sans) of size window units (default 15), which apply then. Not valid unless open.
window_pick vkf_window Subroutine

What is under point (x, y) of the window (-1 to 1 across it, y up: as the event handler's positions), nearest first (see the module documentation): none before the first frame. tolerance: how close lines, markers and frames' origins must be, in window units (logical pixels; default 4), beyond half a line's width or a marker's size. kinds: only hits of these kinds (PICK_*; the others aren't tested). nearest: only the nearest hit (cheaper: what is deeper than a hit found is skipped, e.g. to pick on every mouse move). Frames and artists can be left out (set_pickable(.false.)).
window_view vkf_window Function

View i (1 to num_views).
window_viewer vkf_window Function

The window's viewer handle in the rendering layer (null until open), for adding low-level nodes (src/vsg/vkf_layer.f90).
window_wall vkf_window Function

The window's wall time (s): the wall clock's, or while recording the video's (its start, plus a frame's time per frame drawn).
world_matrix vkf_frames Function

The transform from this frame to the root of its tree, through the first parent at each level.
world_to_view vkf_view Function

The transform from the root frame to the view frame (4x4), from the frames' current positions and attitudes.
wrapped_time vkf_follower Function

For FOLLOW_LOOP, t wrapped into the combined time range of the trajectories.
write_changed vkf_artists Function

The points written as the trajectory changed: the chain made again if its colors are drawn now or no longer (its first colors, or the setting), then the points new since the last written (and the last one again: set_optional; and those whose colors came since), or all of them on a redraw (cleared, a new trajectory or data sources). False if the chain isn't built.
write_colors vkf_artists Subroutine

The colors of points i1 .. i2 into the chain: the trajectory's, and the artist's color for points without one yet.
write_curve vkf_artists Subroutine

Write points i1 .. i2 into the chain (and upload the chunks written to).
write_intermediates vkf_artists Subroutine

Write intermediate markers i1 .. i2 into their chain, with their colors (with point colors), and upload the chunks written to.
write_marker vkf_artists Subroutine

A single marker's point (in a chain of one marker), and its color (a colored chain), uploaded.
write_region vkf_shadow Subroutine

A region's frustum into its mesh (uploaded), and shown or hidden.
write_ribbon vkf_artists Subroutine

Write the pairs of trajectory points i1 .. i2 into the chain, with their colors (and upload the chunks written to).
write_segments vkf_artists Subroutine

Write segments s1 .. s2 into the chain (and upload the chunks written to).
write_segments vkf_line_segments Subroutine

The segments into the chain: segment i as points 2i-1 (a) and 2i (b), with their colors; uploaded, and drawn.
written vkf_line_chain Subroutine

Points i1 .. i2 were written: measure a strip's distances along it (from the distance at point i1-1), update its level of detail, and upload the chunks holding them. x: the points in double precision, x(:, i) for chain point i (at least i1-1 .. i2), to measure from; without it, from the floats written. (i2 is the last point written in the chain.)
zoom_speed vkf_window Function

The zoom speed (set_zoom_speed).
Help

Graph Key

Nodes of different colours represent the following:

Solid arrows point from a procedure to one which it calls. Dashed arrows point from an interface to procedures which implement that interface. This could include the module procedures in a generic interface or the implementation in a submodule of an interface in a parent module.
